posts.title:
Two games in.
[Don't panic.]
posts.lead: Week 1 is when people make the worst drops of the season. Before you cut anyone:
bullets: Count the minutes, not the points
A cold shooter still playing 34 minutes is fine
Two games is not a sample
Nobody's season is decided in October
Drop the bench guy, not the star

caption.instagram:
Two NBA games in. Don't panic. 🏀

Before you drop anyone:
1️⃣ Count the minutes, not the points. Minutes predict the season
2️⃣ Two games is not a sample
3️⃣ Your round-1 pick stays. Drop the bench guy, not the star

Who are you panicking about? 👇
